limitations: Single-venue ticker only; top-of-book sizes are not full depth.
Kraken ticker response has no event timestamp; retrieval time is not a valid substitute for source event time.
No cross-venue synchronized snapshot or depth curve was captured.
Balances are publicly attributed XRPL wallets, including hot/cold and custody balances; not tradable float.
The 7-day and 30-day changes compare only the same wallet set and cannot distinguish customer withdrawals from exchange internal transfers or movements to unlabeled wallets.
Newly tracked wallets are excluded from same-wallet changes; two newly tracked wallets added 512M XRP and would distort naive total changes.
About 489.1M XRP in the total is described as wrapped-asset reserves, insurance or charity funds, not customer exchange deposits.
The 22.33B broad attributed-wallet total is not comparable to narrower single-venue reserve series such as CryptoQuant or Glassnode.
The 1.20B ETF/index figure includes an index product and fund holding dates range from 2026-09-28 to 2026-11-03; it is not a single synchronized spot-ETF snapshot.
Evernorth 473.3M is company-reported at closing; only about 103.1M is currently attributed to on-ledger wallets, with about 370.3M moved to unattributed addresses.
RWA represented registry tokens of about USD 4.06B are not freely transferable investor float; only about USD 276M is described as distributed transferable value.
Ripple operational holdings are static company-reported Q3 2024 figures and founder holdings are estimates, not current on-chain balances.
The headline zero is incomplete: Bitwise and 21Shares reported zero; Franklin Templeton, Canary and Grayscale were marked not reported for the 2026-11-03 session.
T+1 publication; do not treat missing fund reports as zero flow.
Provider coverage and contract universes differ materially; do not average or treat the difference as an error without reconciling venue/contract coverage.
Snapshots are several hours old at retrieval; no synchronized exchange-level raw feed was captured.
Funding snapshots are not a synchronized settlement ledger; positive means longs pay shorts, but quotes can change before settlement.
Long/short account ratios from other providers are account counts, not notional positioning; do not interpret them as leverage or net exposure.

data_quality: No immutable raw-byte SHA-256 receipts were captured for the web-rendered sources; all web-derived market and issuer metrics are excluded from model training until archived by the ingestion service.
Kraken ticker API response has no source event timestamp; capture time cannot be substituted for event time.

XRP Insights exchange balances are broad attributed wallet totals, not tradable float; the same-wallet methodology is better than naive total subtraction but still cannot identify customer withdrawals or unlabeled-wallet transfers.
ETF flow headline zero is incomplete because only 2 of 5 XRP funds reported on 2026-11-03.
Derivatives open-interest totals differ because providers cover different numbers of venues/contracts; no reconciliation or average is valid without contract-level records.
Circle Q3 headline revenue includes ARC token presale revenue; reserve income fell 8% year over year and average USDC circulation was down sequentially from Q2 despite year-over-year growth.
Coinbase's approximately 50% USDC-economics statement is a management claim; Circle's disclosed distribution-cost formula is the better contractual source.
The Ripple National Trust Bank is a national trust bank; do not equate this with a full-service commercial bank or assume deposit-insurance status.
Kamilah Stevenson person identity is well supported, but her own YouTube channel handle remains unverified because first-party cross-linking is absent and she warns of impersonator pages.
